body:
**Verification:** Production testing is done. Smoke tested the Contact is created in Salesforce trigger on Production, all 11 checks:

| # | Activity | What was checked | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Activities list | The list opens with 9 activities in order: Add Prospect, Move, Unsubscribed, Finished, Replied, Paused, Resume, Tag, Blacklist. No "No Data" box and no "Select a list" field. | Pass |
| 2 | Add Prospect | Workflow COMPLETED. One prospect with First Name, Last Name, Email, Phone Number and Department as mapped, Latest Status Inactive. | Pass |
| 3 | Add Prospect | A Contact with a Last Name only is imported with the Last Name kept and First Name empty. | Pass |
| 4 | Move Prospect to another Sequence | A new Contact's prospect is in the sequence. | Pass |
| 5 | Assign a tag to Prospect | A new Contact's prospect is imported and tagged TagA. | Pass |
| 6 | Mark Prospect as Paused | Latest Status Paused. Activities shows "has been paused for 1 days for sequence <sequence name>". | Pass |
| 7 | Mark Prospect as Resume(Un-pause) | A paused prospect becomes Active again. | Pass |
| 8 | Mark Prospect as Replied | Latest Status Replied. | Pass |
| 9 | Mark Prospect as Finished | Latest Status Finished. | Pass |
| 10 | Mark Prospect as Unsubscribed | Latest Status Unsubscribed. | Pass |
| 11 | Blacklist a Domain | The domain is on the Do Not Contact list and no prospect is imported. | Pass |
waitingFor: QA to send via npm run jira. Source: Contact is created in Salesforce Production smoke run 2026-11-12, sequence 997962, account emailopenedprod, dev org saleshandy-dev-ed. 11 of 11 checks passed at least once (checks 2 and 3 passed on a rerun after their first workflow runs ERRORED at Loop on Contacts, an old no-Email Contact in the window). QA approved the wording and asked to leave the Note out.
